cause: The generated recovery Compose configuration inherited explicit source volume and network names. Recovery PostgreSQL briefly mounted the source PostgreSQL volume and the source database process stopped.
containment: Recovery PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO containers were stopped and removed before pg_restore or object import. The source PostgreSQL container was restarted. Its schema remained 20260924_0035, readiness returned 200, and pg_amcheck completed with exit 0.
fix: Recovery volumes and network now use azaeron-verity-dr names. The gate asserts actual Docker mounts before it connects to recovery PostgreSQL.
retest: restore-isolated.log and restore-pre-replay.json show a separate database and 363 copied objects; post-erasure replay and final readiness remain separately gated.
